title: Web Design Sharjah: Websites and Online Stores | The Brandle
description: Web design for Sharjah businesses from a studio one emirate away. Bilingual websites and stores, 5% VAT handled, fixed prices from $1,299.

hub.name: Web design Sharjah
hub.line: One emirate over, same time zone.

hero.joke: Your customers already spend an hour in Sharjah to Dubai traffic. Your website shouldn't make them wait as well.
hero.intro: Web design for Sharjah businesses, from a studio one emirate away in Dubai. Bilingual websites and online stores for family firms, schools, clinics and shops, with 5% UAE VAT, local payment methods and Arabic designed properly. Fixed prices from $1,299.

items.p: Many Sharjah customers would rather read in Arabic, so both languages get designed, not just translated. Our [Arabic and RTL guide](/blog/arabic-rtl-website-design/) shows what that means.
Clear pages for parents, patients and regulars: opening hours, fees, locations and a phone number that works with one tap.
Cards, Apple Pay and instalments through Tabby or Tamara, for shoppers who expect them at checkout.
5% UAE VAT shown and invoiced correctly, with your tax registration number where it belongs.
Licence details and legal pages set out for your set-up, whether that's a Sharjah free zone like SAIF Zone or Shams, or the mainland.
Google Business Profile matched to the site, so people searching nearby find the right branch, not the one that closed.

fit.p: Because Sharjah and Dubai share a clock and a working week, so calls happen when you're actually at your desk. We know the VAT rules and the free zones already. Past that, judge us on the work.
yes: A Sharjah family business finally getting a proper site
A school, nursery or clinic that parents need to find fast
A shop that wants to start selling online
In need of Arabic and English that both look intended
fit.no: you're selling mainly to Dubai, then [web design Dubai](/services/web-design-dubai/) fits better. If you only need the checkout fixed, see [payment gateway integration](/services/payment-gateway-integration/).

proof.label: Our own work
proof.p: SameTicket is our own site comparing ticket prices for attractions in Dubai, Abu Dhabi, Sharjah and Ras Al Khaimah. We built it and we run it, so Sharjah's attractions are already part of our day job.

items.p: A free call in your working hours. You get a written scope and a fixed quote.
Key pages designed in Figma, in Arabic and English side by side.
Built on the platform that fits how you work, with payments connected in test mode.
Payments tested, map profile matched, site live. Free fixes for 30 days.

price.p: Websites start at $1,299, about AED 4,800, and you can [price yours](/pricing/) item by item, and a site or store takes 3 to 6 weeks. For how that compares with the rest of the UAE market, read [how much a website costs in Dubai](/blog/website-cost-dubai/). The numbers don't change at the border.

faq.q: How much does a website cost in Sharjah?
faq.a: Websites start at $1,299, about AED 4,800, fixed before work starts. Two languages and online payments add scope, and the quote will say so.
No, we're in Dubai, one emirate away and in the same time zone. Most of the work happens on video calls and in shared documents, and we reply within one business day.

faq.q: Can you handle VAT on our store?
faq.a: Yes. 5% UAE VAT shown at checkout and on invoices, with your tax registration number in place. Your accountant still files the return, sadly.
